title: Fix Master Monday CFGI live-anchor readback
objective: Repair the bounded Master Monday preflight CFGI readback so current DAILY_LIVE_ANCHOR_INDEX_v3 observations persisted under market_metrics.sentiment.cfgi.symbols.{MARKET,BTC,ETH} are consumed as existing evidence instead of being reported UNAVAILABLE. Preserve fail-closed behavior and any supported legacy flat CFGI representation. Do not alter capture cadence, source calls, market semantics, thresholds or historical evidence.

evidence.summary: Current v3 capture contains fresh PASS CFGI observations under market_metrics.sentiment.cfgi.symbols for BTC, ETH and MARKET.
Pre-move 04:34Z capture preserves BTC 45, ETH 47 and MARKET 49.5 CFGI scores under the current symbols nesting.
Pre-move 08:53Z capture preserves BTC 47.5, ETH 48.5 and MARKET 48 CFGI observations while breadth had already risen to 77/100.
Current preflight assigns cfgi=market_metrics.sentiment.cfgi and then reads cfgi.get(MARKET/BTC/ETH), omitting the current symbols nesting and causing A46-A48 false UNAVAILABLE.
Analogous weekly CFGI reader mismatch was already fixed on main; this candidate must not duplicate or broaden that repair.

allowed_change_scope: tests/master_monday directly covering preflight CFGI readback
.github/workflows/master-monday-preflight-gate.yml only if required to execute the added regression test
forbidden_changes: Daily Live Anchor capture code or cadence
CFGI source calls or API budget
build_weekly_cfgi_summary.py unless fresh reproduction proves the Sep 3 fix is insufficient
backfilling observations that were not captured ex ante
reproduction: On fresh main, use a current DAILY_LIVE_ANCHOR_INDEX_v3 fixture matching the persisted Sep 2-3 captures where market_metrics.sentiment.cfgi.symbols contains MARKET, BTC and ETH observations. Run build_preflight_package_v3.py. Observe that A46-A48 read cfgi.get(name) from the parent object and therefore report UNAVAILABLE even though the persisted observations exist under cfgi.symbols.

positive: A current v3 fixture with market_metrics.sentiment.cfgi.symbols.MARKET/BTC/ETH causes A46, A47 and A48 to PASS with the exact persisted observation objects.
The emitted preflight top-level cfgi payload exposes those exact current observations for downstream weekly calibration.
Any supported legacy flat CFGI shape remains readable without changing historical evidence.
Master Monday preflight unit tests and master-monday-preflight-gate pass.
negative: Missing, malformed or non-dict CFGI data remains explicit UNAVAILABLE and is never inferred, forward-filled or substituted.
No source call, capture cadence, market rule, threshold, model weight or portfolio authority changes are introduced.
No historical capture, weekly summary or raw artifact is rewritten to make the test pass.

clean_noop_condition: Fresh main already reads current market_metrics.sentiment.cfgi.symbols correctly in Master Monday preflight and a regression test proves A46-A48 PASS; if so, stop without code changes and close the candidate as superseded/no-op.
stop_condition: Stop without code changes if reproduction fails, the required fix exceeds the bounded preflight/test scope, or implementation would require changing capture semantics, market authority, thresholds, source calls or historical evidence.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER only if current and legacy CFGI representations cannot be supported deterministically without changing evidence semantics.
rollback_plan: Revert only the bounded Master Monday preflight/readback code and directly related regression test. Preserve all Sep 1-4 captures, Hourly, Shadow, Pullback Forensics and historical CFGI evidence unchanged.
